author: Nicole Mayer
text: My son has just changed over to Libre 2 plus and we had trouble with his first two sensors, Abbott said it’s because his phone is running an OS higher than the one the sensors use and that’s why the issue with being disconnected for hours overnight, they said they’d send us a reader too, she said to scan sensor with phone first and then the reader so you get alarms, makes no sense to me, luckily third sensor now on and seems to be working fine with the OS, maybe they’ve updated it or it’s just the line they’ve been told to give us 🤷🏻‍♀️

author: Pat DesLauriers
text: Scan to begin sensor and that's it. Reader doesn't have all little extra dohickies the app has but it gives you what you need. To get your glucose just turn it on and press 'view glucose'.  I like using reader when I'm at family gatherings as it's in my pocket and not among 20+ phones spread out on tables..
